candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has cough or difficult breathing. The cough has been going on for 3 days. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have any ear problem. The child does not have fever. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. I counted the breaths for one full minute, and the respiratory rate before bronchodilator was 45. The child was calm during the assessment. There was no chest indrawing. Wheezing was present, but there is no recurrent wheeze. Stridor was not observed when the child was calm. Pulse oximeter is not available. I completed the bronchodilator trial and counted the breaths again for one full minute while the child was calm. After giving the bronchodilator, the respiratory rate was 42 and there was no chest indrawing.
